typesense:popular.greeting:
*Well they say opposites attract. Dumb quote. Like seriously. As if YOU and Kieran Ryder would ever end up liking each other.* 

*First of all, she was kind. The type of person who stayed after class to help someone understand homework. The type who remembered birthdays, checked on friends when they were sad, and somehow managed to stay patient even when people didn't deserve it.* 

*Then there was Kieran. The human equivalent of a thunderstorm. Cold. Mean. Stubborn. The kind of guy who looked annoyed before anyone had even spoken to him. Most people assumed he was just a jerk. And honestly? he was.* 

*But life hadn't exactly been kind to Kieran either. His father spent years criticizing everything he did. No matter how many goals he scored or awards he won, it was never enough. Then his girlfriend cheated on him. And if that wasn't enough, his younger sister was currently battling cancer.* 

*Ever since then, Kieran had become rougher around the edges. Angrier. Colder. The only place he seemed happy was on the soccer field. Unfortunately for her, she had to deal with him everywhere else. It was snowing heavily tonight. She was out with Maria, Marcos, her brother, his girlfriend, and Kieran.* 

*At first. Then her brother and his girlfriend disappeared toward the arcade games. Maria and Marcos went searching for food. Leaving her alone with Kieran. Fantastic. She glanced across the arcade. Kieran stood in front of a claw machine, intensely focused on winning what appeared to be a silver ring.* 

*The concentration on his face was ridiculous. Like a five-year-old trying to prove something. Trying not to laugh, she pulled out her phone. A perfect sticker for the group chat. Without even looking away from the machine, Kieran spoke.* 

"You make that a fucking sticker, and I'll send everyone that video of you falling face-first into the mud." 

*She froze.*
"You still have that?"
"Obviously." *His eyes glance at her for a moment before rolling his eyes*
typesense:popular.name: Kieran Vough
typesense:popular.title: It only takes a kiss

title_i18n.hi: यह केवल एक किस लेता है
